summary: Iteration 16 - Complete testing of 4 UI changes. All tests PASSED: 1) Parts section at TOP of device modal (before Gerätetyp), 2) Add part form has WHITE background (not purple), 3) Maintenance history entries are collapsible by default, 4) Expanded entries show ALL 6 sections with 3-state status badges.

parts_section_position.test: Device edit modal for XBAP2021 - parts section order
parts_section_position.result: Parts section (Ersatzteile) appears BEFORE Gerätetyp selector. Section order: device-image-section -> parts-section -> geraetetyp-section. Position check: partsTop=253, typeTop=390

parts_form_white_background.test: Add part form background color check
parts_form_white_background.result: Background color is rgb(255, 255, 255) - WHITE (not fuchsia/purple). Verified with getComputedStyle.

add_ersatzteil.test: Add new Ölfilter part with part number TEST-ITER16
add_ersatzteil.result: Part added successfully. Existing part (Kraftstofffilter 265272) visible in list.

delete_ersatzteil.result: Delete button visible and clickable on each part (data-testid='delete-part-{id}')

save_device_no_500_error.test: Save device changes without ObjectId serialization error
save_device_no_500_error.result: Modal closed after save - no 500 error. Device with image_gridfs_id saved successfully.

entries_collapsed_by_default.test: Maintenance history entries on DSE-HBF-001 plan detail
entries_collapsed_by_default.result: All 8 entries collapsed by default. Each entry shows only: technician name, date, hours.

expand_collapse_on_click.result: Toggle button (data-testid='entry-toggle-{id}') expands entry on click. Second click collapses entry.

chevron_animation.result: ChevronDown icon has rotate-180 class when expanded. Smooth CSS transition.

all_6_sections_visible.test: Administrator entry shows all 6 sections when expanded
all_6_sections_visible.result: All 6 sections visible: 1. Mechanische Prüfung, 2. Elektrische Prüfung, 3. Generator Messwerte, 4. Lasttest Generator, 5. ATS / Netzumschaltung, 6. Diagnose. Plus Bemerkungen and Notizen.

three_state_badges.result: Found all 3 badge colors: Green (bg-emerald - Durchgeführt), Gray (bg-gray - Nicht durchgeführt), Amber (bg-amber - Nicht vorhanden). Administrator entry has 15 green, 1 gray, 1 amber badges.
